# Summary

Automated checks evaluate completeness, validity, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and geographic accuracy for each inbound dataset. Scores are stored in `data_quality_scores` and issues in `data_quality_issues`.

# Common findings

## Environmental samples (VEPA)

- Missing pollutant values
- Unexpected units (e.g., ppm instead of µg/m³)
- Extreme outliers
- Invalid district codes
- Duplicate site–period–pollutant rows

## Health observations (Ministry of Health)

- Unknown facility codes
- Late reporting dates after period close
- Missing indicator values

## Population / SES (Statistics Office)

- Missing total population for selected communities

# Recommended corrections

1. Enforce controlled vocabularies for units and geographic codes at source
2. Reject or quarantine outliers before national consolidation
3. Align facility master lists with the national organisation-unit hierarchy
4. Submit facility aggregates within two weeks of period close

# Facility-level completeness

Analysts can join `health_observations` to `health_facilities` and compare expected versus received facility–period combinations for the latest quarter.
